findings.title: The main description uses difficult technical words
findings.evidence: “Leverage our multimodal generative narrative engine to synthesise bespoke, heirloom-grade story artefacts from your household's lived-experience corpus.”
findings.why: I only have intermediate English, and these long technical words make me work before I understand what the service does.

findings.title: The hero image has no description
findings.evidence: [image (no description) 430x440]
findings.why: I cannot understand whether the image is an example of the finished book or just decoration.

findings.title: The initial price information is not enough to judge the service
findings.evidence: “Free digital preview · Printed hardcovers shipped across the UK”
findings.why: I know the preview is free, but I do not yet know what a printed hardcover costs or whether there are extra charges.

findings.title: Email and password fields have no proper labels
findings.evidence: [5] and [6] are described as “textbox (no label)” and only show the placeholders “Email” and “Password.”
findings.why: I can understand the boxes now, but labelled fields are clearer and easier to use with assistive technology.

findings.title: Footer links have very low contrast
findings.evidence: The footer text “Privacy,” “Terms,” and “Contact” is shown in very pale grey on a nearly white background.
findings.why: The words are difficult for me to read.

findings.title: Unclear technical error
findings.evidence: “Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.”
findings.why: I cannot tell whether my family details are safe, whether the book will work, or what I should do to fix it.

findings.title: Dashboard uses the account name instead of my name
findings.evidence: “Welcome back, Demo”
findings.why: It feels less personal and makes me check that I am in the correct account.

findings.title: Footer links have very low contrast
findings.evidence: “Privacy”, “Terms”, and “Contact” appear very pale grey in the footer.
findings.why: I can hardly read these links, and I may not notice privacy or help information.

findings.title: The example uses a Western name instead of showing culturally varied names
findings.evidence: The placeholder says "e.g. Grandma Rose"
findings.why: It may make my family's names and relationships feel less welcome, especially because the name “Bà Nội” has Vietnamese meaning and diacritics.

findings.title: The relationship dropdown does not explain what to do if the other person has more than one relationship
findings.evidence: [11] combobox "Relationship" options [*Grandparent | Parent | Sibling | Friend | Pet | Other]
findings.why: I need to say that Bà Nội is my child's grandmother, and “Grandparent” is clear, but the form does not show whether I can add more detail.

findings.title: No visible reminder that the entered family details can be reviewed
findings.evidence: The page only says “Your story” and does not show Linh or Bà Nội’s saved details.
findings.why: I want to be sure the story will use Linh, Bà Nội, and the exact memory I provide.

findings.title: Reading-level choices use an unexplained technical scale
findings.evidence: The heading says “Reading level,” but the options say “Lexile BR–200L,” “Lexile 200L–500L,” “Lexile 500L–800L,” and “Lexile 800L+.”
findings.why: I do not know what Lexile means, so I cannot confidently choose the right level for Linh, who is four.

findings.title: The preselected reading level is not explained
findings.evidence: [22] radio “Lexile 200L–500L” (checked)
findings.why: I worry the preselected range may be too difficult for my daughter, and I do not know why it was selected for me.

findings.title: Story text was silently cut off after 200 characters
findings.evidence: The previous field “Tell us the memory or idea behind your story” showed “200 characters” and the end of the memory disappeared after “they float the lantern”.
findings.why: The important action of floating the lantern on the river was lost. The website accepted the form without telling me that my family memory was incomplete.

findings.title: File upload control has no visible label
findings.evidence: [30] file-upload (no label)
findings.why: I can understand the instruction, but the upload control itself only says “Choose file” and does not clearly identify what kind of file to choose.

findings.title: The title is misspelled
findings.evidence: The title shown twice is “The Magical Adventrue of Linh.”
findings.why: This is my family story, and a spelling mistake in the title makes the result feel less finished and makes me worried about other names and cultural details.

findings.title: The selected illustration style was not used
findings.evidence: The cover says “Illustration style: Pop-art comic,” but I selected “Watercolour — soft and dreamy.”
findings.why: I chose the style carefully, so changing it without telling me makes me distrust the result.

findings.title: The cover does not clearly represent the requested family memory
findings.evidence: The cover picture shows a rocket, red hanging circles, the sun, and a child labelled “Linh”; the requested river, Bà Nội, and star-shaped lantern are not visible.
findings.why: I wanted a story about Linh and Bà Nội making lanterns in Hoi An, so this picture does not show the memory I entered.

findings.title: The regenerate action has a cost without a clear explanation
findings.evidence: The offscreen button is labelled “Regenerate entire book – $4.99.”
findings.why: I am careful about prices and do not want to spend money by accident.

findings.title: The final story sentence is incomplete
findings.evidence: “And from that day on, whenever Linh looked up at the sky, she would always remember”
findings.why: The book is for a four-year-old, and the last sentence should feel complete and clear. This ending may confuse Linh.

findings.title: Premium gift wrap is selected by default
findings.evidence: [5] checkbox "Premium gift wrap" (checked), with “£7.99”
findings.why: I might accidentally pay £7.99 for something I did not choose. This makes the total feel less trustworthy.

findings.title: Gift wrap contents are not explained
findings.evidence: “Premium gift wrap” with only the price “£7.99”
findings.why: I cannot judge whether the extra service is worth the money.

findings.title: Generated book title is inconsistent
findings.evidence: Page content says “The Magical Adventrue of Linh,” while the screenshot shows “The Magical Adventure of Linh”
findings.why: This looks like a spelling mistake in the product I would order. I do not want to buy a book with a wrong title.

findings.title: Checkout does not explain what the reserved price covers
findings.evidence: “Your price is reserved for 09:57”
findings.why: I do not know if I must finish now, what happens after the timer, or whether the book price can change.

findings.title: The checkout title does not match the generated book title
findings.evidence: The preview title was “The Magical Adventrue of Linh,” but checkout says “Hardcover: The Magical Adventure of Linh.”
findings.why: I do not know whether the misspelled preview is being corrected or whether I am looking at a different book. I would be afraid of paying for the wrong thing.

findings.title: The price-reservation message is unclear and adds pressure
findings.evidence: “Your price is reserved for 09:15” appears in red without explaining whether this means minutes and seconds or a clock time.
findings.why: I do not know how long I have, and the red message makes me feel rushed. A countdown should not pressure me into buying.
